skill.summary: Guides startups and scale-ups through SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS compliance to achieve audit readiness without external consultants.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Compliance & Audit Readiness Engine.

- Guides startups and scale-ups through SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and SOX compliance.
- Provides a framework selection matrix with triggers, timelines, and cost ranges for each standard.
- Includes a structured company readiness assessment template.
- Outlines decision rules to prioritize compliance actions based on business drivers and data types.
- Contains a detailed SOC 2 readiness checklist (by Trust Service Criteria) and 16-week project plan.
- Lists required policy documents for achieving audit readiness.
